display.purpose: Largest page/screen title, one per view at most.

body.purpose: Default UI text, form values, table cells — the workhorse.

label.purpose: Field labels, column headers, badges, metadata.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: The single soft lift on cards and panels (~95% opacity over --app-ground).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and sheets above dimmed content.

motion.name: ease-out-cubic
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances and state transitions (150-250ms).

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Slightly sharper settle for overlays and reveals.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Most control-level transitions; users are in flow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:none; border-radius:var(--radius-md, 8px); background:var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color:var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font:500 0.875rem/1 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 1px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, box-shadow .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)) 90%, transparent); box-shadow:0 4px 12px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.10); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0.5px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: At most one supporting action alongside the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:none; border-radius:var(--radius-md, 8px); background:var(--secondary, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color:var(--secondary-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); font:500 0.875rem/1 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--secondary, oklch(0.97 0 0)) 80%, oklch(0 0 0)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Tertiary and toolbar actions; importance via variant, not color.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius:var(--radius-md, 8px); background:var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font:500 0.875rem/1 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field with the signature ring-on-focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display:flex; width:100%; height:36px; padding:4px 12px; border:1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius:var(--radius-md, 8px); background:transparent; color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font:400 0.875rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04); outline:none; transition:border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color:var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)) 20%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Grounded content container with a soft rest lift.
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; padding:24px; border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius:var(--radius-xl, 14px); background:var(--card, oklch(1 0 0)); color:var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); box-shadow:0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 1px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-card-title { font:600 1.125rem/1.3 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-card-body { font:400 0.875rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic status pill — the primary legitimate use of color in tables.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:var(--radius-md, 8px); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--success, oklch(0.6 0.13 150)) 12%, transparent); color:var(--success, oklch(0.6 0.13 150)); font:500 0.75rem/1.4 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Bedrock's UI should read like a finished, shipped admin product from the first paint — never a scaffold or a demo. An operator sitting down at it feels like they've opened a real, mature tool, and the interface disappears into the task. The voice is soft-gloss-minimal, warm and precise: a warm, accent-tinted canvas with cards at ~95% opacity that lift on a single soft shadow, gloss used as a specific effect and never as decoration. Bedrock ships an Indigo brand by default, carried entirely by one white-label token (--primary) an adopter swaps to rebrand; generated screens stay indistinguishable from hand-built ones.
keyCharacteristics: Production-credible from the first paint; earned familiarity over novelty.
Warm, accent-tinted canvas with soft-gloss-minimal cards (~95% opacity, one soft lift).
Indigo brand by default, carried entirely by a single white-label token.
Color carries meaning only — state and the one brand accent.
One primary action per view; importance via hierarchy, never ad-hoc color.
Brand is a single token; generated and hand-built screens are visually identical.

rules.name: The Single-Knob Rule
rules.body: Brand identity lives in exactly one token pair (--primary / --primary-foreground, light + dark). A brand color is never hard-coded into a component; rebranding is a one-line change.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color is reserved for the brand accent (primary actions, current selection, state indicators) and the semantic quartet. Everything else is neutral; chromatic pixels stay a small minority.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are a fixed rem scale in a tight ~1.2 ratio, never fluid clamp(). Operators view at consistent DPI across long sessions.

rules.name: The Soft-Gloss Rule
rules.body: Depth is one soft lift plus ~95% translucency over the warm ground — no stacked shadows, no hard shadow, no glass-as-decoration. Legibility outranks the effect. Focus is the brand ring, never a shadow.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: Exactly one primary button per view. Competing primaries destroy the hierarchy that makes an operator fast.

rules.name: The Seven States Rule
rules.body: Every interactive component defines default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, and error. Shipping half of them is shipping an unfinished component.

rules.name: The Parity Rule
rules.body: A screen scaffolded by the generator must be visually and structurally indistinguishable from a hand-built one — same components, tokens, and states. Bedrock's defining constraint.

dos: Do rebrand through the single --primary / --primary-foreground token pair (light + dark); optionally match --ring and --sidebar-primary.
Do keep saturated color for the brand accent and the semantic quartet only; let neutrals carry everything else.
Do use hairline borders as the primary structural device, with soft Rest/Raised/Overlay shadows layered on for elevation.
Do use a fixed rem type scale in a tight ratio, one Geist family across the whole UI.
Do give every component all seven states, skeletons for loading, and teaching empty states.
Do keep generated and hand-built screens on the exact same components and tokens (Parity Rule).
Do let overlays escape their container (dialog, popover, portal) so dropdowns never clip inside overflow ancestors.
donts: Don't hard-code a brand color into a component or express importance with ad-hoc color instead of variant.
Don't use color as decoration, or put more than one primary action in a view.
Don't use hard, heavy, or exaggerated shadows, or communicate focus with a shadow instead of the ring.
Don't use fluid clamp() type sizing or display fonts in labels, buttons, or data.
Don't reach for a modal as the first solution — exhaust inline and progressive alternatives first.
Don't invent non-standard affordances (custom scrollbars, odd form controls) for standard admin tasks.
